title: Founder case: Madam C. J. Walker builds distribution

sources.claim: Madam C. J. Walker sold her hair-care products door to door, advertised in African American newspapers, trained and recruited sales agents, ran a mail-order business and beauty school, and incorporated her company in Indianapolis in 1910.

sections.skill: Apply a documented early decision: build distribution through trained agents

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: According to the passage, how did Walker first sell products?
questions.correct_answer: Door to door
questions.intro: Documented history (Indiana Historical Society): Madam C. J. Walker sold her hair-care products door to door, advertised in African American newspapers, trained and recruited sales agents, ran a mail-order business and a beauty school, and incorporated her company in Indianapolis in 1910. Lesson drawn by this course (an interpretation): build several channels that reach your customers directly, and train other people to sell and teach, so the business is not limited to one person's time. One success story does not guarantee the same result for another business.
